edges.description: Mutant desmoplakin fails to incorporate stably at cortical desmosomal plaques and accumulates abnormally in the keratinocyte cytoplasm.
Biallelic DSP impairment compromises desmosomal integrity in keratinizing hair follicles and the nail apparatus, inferred clinically from woolly hair, alopecia, and nail dystrophy.
edges.target: Hair Follicle and Nail Apparatus Adhesion Failure

edges.description: Depletion of properly localized plaque desmoplakin uncouples suprabasal keratin intermediate filaments from intercellular desmosomal junctions.
Desmosomes deprived of intermediate-filament anchorage cannot sustain tensile stress across epidermal layers.
Pan-epidermal acantholysis causes non-scarring intraepidermal blistering and erosions upon minimal mechanical friction.
High mechanical load on plantar and palmar epidermis drives focal, striate, or diffuse compensatory hyperkeratosis with painful fissuring.
Chronic epidermal junctional instability induces hyperkeratotic plaques on the trunk, limbs, and perioral skin.
Disrupted desmosomal adhesion in hair-follicle epithelium distorts hair shaft morphogenesis, producing tightly curled woolly hair.

evidence.reference_title: Novel Compound Heterozygous Variants of DSP Causing Skin Fragility-Woolly Hair Syndrome: A Rare Case Report and Literature Review.
evidence.snippet: Two heterozygous variants in exon 24 of DSP, c.7642C>T (p.R2548X) and c.6449delC (p.R2151Gfs*3), were identified by whole-exome sequencing and further proven to be a novel compound heterozygous variant by Sanger sequencing.

nodes.description: Biallelic pathogenic variants in DSP impair desmoplakin's structural plaque-linker activity. Documented causal genotypes include compound heterozygosity pairing a nonsense premature-termination allele with a missense substitution (p.Cys809Ter/p.Asn287Lys and p.Gln664Ter/p.Arg2366Cys), compound heterozygosity for exon 24 nonsense and frameshift truncations (p.Arg2548Ter/p.Arg2151GlyfsTer3), and homozygosity for C-terminal plakin-repeat missense substitutions at codon Arg2366 (p.Arg2366His, p.Arg2366Cys). Whereas monoallelic carrier status for these alleles is clinically silent in parents, biallelic reduction and C-terminal/N-terminal domain perturbation compromise desmoplakin's capacity to bridge desmosomal plaque proteins to keratin intermediate filaments.

nodes.description: Loss of functional peripheral desmoplakin in epidermal keratinocytes uncouples the keratin intermediate filament cytoskeleton from the desmosomal plaque, resulting ultrastructurally in perinuclear condensation (retraction) of the suprabasal keratin filament network and focal detachment of desmosomes into the intercellular spaces.
